mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Yield curve inverts (10y-2y < 0) within the next 6 months, or GDP growth decelerates in the following quarter.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50 for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in industrial activity that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) of more than 0.5 percentage points over 3 months signals a rapidly weakening labor market, which will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are positive on more than 60% of occasions when the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and rising, it signals a tightening monetary policy that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) both show year-over-year growth above 5%, it signals a strong consumer demand environment that will boost S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 30% of instances when both proxies show strong growth.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) is growing by more than 200,000 per month, it signals a tight labor market that will lead to wage inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when both labor market conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3% and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2%, it signals a potential inflationary surge that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are positive on more than 60% of occasions when both monetary conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is above its 12-month moving average and the ISM manufacturing index is also expanding, it signals a positive supply-side environment that will support S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when the supply-side conditions are met.
